title: Glass Shelf, 22-Inch Double With Gallery Rail, Solid Brass, Wall Mount - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage without adding bulk to the vanity? This wall-mounted double glass shelf gives you two levels for everyday toiletries, with a gallery rail designed to keep items in place.

  • More organized storage: double shelf design creates two tiers for bottles, soaps, and décor
  • More secure placement: gallery rail is designed to keep items from sliding off the shelf
  • Strength you can trust: made with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass
  • Enduring hardware: solid brass construction with concealed screw mounting for a clean look
  • Coordinate the room: part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place and other transitional bath accessories

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 22 x 5 Inches
  • Overall dimensions: 22 in (L) x 5 in (W/projection) x 8 in (H)
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-inch)
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount (concealed screw mounting hardware)
  • Assembly required: False
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")

Designed to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware in the Waverly Place collection, with multiple designer finish options available.
